answer: Every candidate carries a provenance record of source, ref, retrieval_time, hash (sha256:<hex>), and retrieval_method. A second agent given only that record re-fetched identical bytes for 10/10 sampled candidates by executing posix-read and tar-member against the recorded source+ref. A record with a mutated ref that still has all five fields fails re-fetch with HashMismatch (detector fires on the decoy bytes). Field presence is not acceptance. SUCCESS:IMP-0155

evidence.claim: Re-fetch from the provenance record reproduced the recorded hash for 10/10 sampled candidates (methods ['posix-read', 'tar-member']). Computed, not asserted.

SUCCESS:IMP-0155-probe1 10/10 sampled provenance records re-fetch to recorded hash

evidence.claim: A mutated-ref record fails re-fetch (HashMismatch on an existing decoy) while the intact record passes. Both-states fired_on_bad=True silent_on_good=True.

probes.raw_output:
both-states method=posix-read good_ok=True mutated_ref=wf-DECOY.json fired=True detector=HashMismatch fields_present_on_mutated=True
both-states method=tar-member good_ok=True mutated_ref=wf-tar-DECOY.json fired=True detector=HashMismatch fields_present_on_mutated=True
SUCCESS:IMP-0155-probe2 mutated-ref fails re-fetch; intact record passes

implementation.note: ref is the fetch key; hash is verified after fetch. A mutated ref cannot succeed by consulting the hash as a locator.

negative_controls.description: posix-read ref mutated to wf-DECOY.json; HashMismatch fires; intact record still re-fetches.
tar-member ref mutated to wf-tar-DECOY.json; HashMismatch fires; intact record still re-fetches.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0154 append-only candidate registry is not delivered on this worktree; provenance attaches to a candidate wrapper and does not invent that registry.

reviewer.method: Named probe2 is mechanically independent of probe1: it mutates only ref on an otherwise complete record and requires HashMismatch, while probe1 samples 10 intact re-fetches.

title: Implement the provenance record: source, ref, retrieval time, hash, retrieval method
